policies.text: An electronic item receives express delivery authorization provided it has a shipping weight under 5 kg and an automated hazard safety score of at least 90.
A commercial device achieves fast-track customs clearance if it possesses a CE Marking and has an import valuation exceeding $50,000.
A medical device receives clearance for clinical distribution when it retains an FDA Class II Clearance.
A solar system gains eligibility for rebate programs in the high-efficiency class when its peak generation capacity reaches 400 W or greater.
An item receives featured homepage placement provided it holds catalog status at the Gold level.
An industrial component meets corporate procurement criteria if it holds an ISO 9001 Certification.

An item earns eco-certification when it meets a maximum sound output of 60 dB, a recycled material proportion of at least 35%, an energy conservation score of 85% or higher, and an operational duration on battery of 10 hours or more, or carries a Global Green Tech Mark.
A product is assigned catalog status at the Gold level provided it has eco-certification and a warranty duration of 2 years or more.
